ideas.children_he: ה׳ מְצַוֶּה לְהַקְדִּישׁ לוֹ כָּל בְּכוֹר בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה. הַבְּכוֹרוֹת שַׁיָּכִים לוֹ.
ideas.children_en: God commands Moses to consecrate every firstborn human and animal, for they belong to Him. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה מְבַקֵּשׁ מֵהָעָם לִזְכֹּר אֶת הַיְּצִיאָה מֵעַבְדוּת מִצְרַיִם. עֲלֵיהֶם לַחְגֹּג וְלֹא לֶאֱכֹל חָמֵץ.
ideas.children_en: Moses commands the people to remember their deliverance from Egypt, avoid leaven, and celebrate in the promised land. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: בְּמֶשֶׁךְ שִׁבְעָה יָמִים אוֹכְלִים מַצּוֹת וּמְסַפְּרִים לַיְלָדִים עַל יְצִיאַת מִצְרַיִם. כָּךְ שׁוֹמְרִים אֶת הַזִּכָּרוֹן.
ideas.children_en: For seven days the people eat unleavened bread, celebrate God, and teach their children about the Exodus; the command becomes a sign and remembrance. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: בָּאָרֶץ הַמֻּבְטַחַת יַקְדִּישׁוּ אֶת הַבְּכוֹרוֹת וְיִפְדּוּ אֶת אֵלֶּה שֶׁנִּצְטַוּוּ לִפְדּוֹת. הַמִּצְוָה מַזְכִּירָה אֶת הַצָּלַת בְּכוֹרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.
ideas.children_en: When Israel reaches the land, the firstborn of people and animals will be dedicated or redeemed, remembering their rescue during the plague of the firstborn. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: אֱלֹהִים מוֹבִיל אֶת הָעָם בַּדֶּרֶךְ הָאֲרֻכָּה בַּמִּדְבָּר. הוּא אֵינוֹ רוֹצֶה שֶׁיִּפְחֲדוּ מִמִּלְחָמָה וְיַחְזְרוּ לְמִצְרַיִם.
ideas.children_en: God avoids the short route through Philistine territory so the people will not fear war and return to Egypt, leading them through the wilderness toward the Red Sea. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה לוֹקֵחַ אִתּוֹ אֶת עַצְמוֹת יוֹסֵף. כָּךְ הוּא מְקַיֵּם אֶת הַהַבְטָחָה לְהָבִיאוֹ לָאָרֶץ הַמֻּבְטַחַת.
ideas.children_en: Moses fulfills the oath of Israel’s ancestors by carrying Joseph’s bones toward the promised land. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יוֹצְאִים מִסֻּכּוֹת. הֵם חוֹנִים בְּאֵתָם, בִּקְצֵה הַמִּדְבָּר.
ideas.children_en: The Israelites journey from Succoth and camp at Etham, at the edge of the wilderness. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.

ideas.children_he: ה׳ מַנְחֶה אֶת הָעָם בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן בַּיּוֹם וּבְעַמּוּד אֵשׁ בַּלַּיְלָה. הָאֵשׁ גַּם מְאִירָה לָהֶם אֶת הַדֶּרֶךְ.
ideas.children_en: God leads the people by a pillar of cloud during the day and a pillar of fire at night, guiding and illuminating them continually. Notice what the people choose to do and what happens next.
